description: Hand a .cook name you own to another wallet. FINAL — only the new owner can move it again. If the name is this wallet's primary, the primary record is cleared in the same instruction so it cannot point at a name the wallet no longer owns. The recipient can be given as an address or as a .cook name. Simulates before sending. Requires COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY.

name.description: the .cook name, with or without the suffix (e.g. "bot" or "bot.cook")

name: transfer_domain
title: Transfer a .cook name
